description: Pay to queue an asynchronous MusicXML render. Request mp3 for listening and/or midi for editing. Hosted clients receive HTTP 402 until they retry with Payment-Signature. Poll musicwire_get_job for artifacts and QC. Musicwire does not compose. Completed jobs also include the source MusicXML, NOTICE.txt, and receipt.json. Reuse idempotency_key when retrying.

constraints_check.description: Optional expected tempo, duration, key, and mode checked during QC.

duration_seconds.description: Expected written duration in seconds for the QC constraints check.

key_fifths.description: Expected key signature fifths, MusicXML circle-of-fifths integer.

mode.description: Expected mode for the QC constraints check.

tempo.description: Expected score tempo in BPM for the QC constraints check.

formats.description: Unique render outputs: mp3 for listening, midi for editing.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse when retrying the same paid request so Musicwire replays the original outcome instead of authorizing another payment.

name: musicwire_render
title: Render MusicXML
